pretreatments.description: Cutting into small pieces using a carpentry chopper (Rasha WSH-T64, Iran)
Powdering using a grinder (Bosch MKM6003, Germany)

Sodium hydroxide (NaOH) pretreatment: presoaking in 8% wt. sodium hydroxide solution (95 g) at room temperature for 10 min with stirring; heating up to 100 °C using an oil bath (Memmert O200, Germany) and holding at this temperature for 10 min; cooling down in an ice bath; centrifugation at 4500 rpm for 15 min; washing with room temperature distilled water until pH of supernatant was close to neutral; freezing in liquid nitrogen and freeze-drying for 48 h
Liquid hot water (LHW) pretreatment: same steps as alkaline pretreatment using distilled water instead of alkaline solution; heating at high temperature and pressure using a high-pressure cooker
Biological pretreatment: aerobic digestion using the aerobic sludge at 37 °C and 90 rpm in a shaker incubator (JAL TAJHIZ, Iran) for 10 days
Ultrasonic pretreatment: incubation in an ultrasonic bath (Soltec SONICA 3200 L ETH S3, Italy, 180 W) at the frequency of 40 KHz for 30 min at 40 °C
